Brief review 2026-09-25 (Indoor slippers creative hub) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. The Source column's bracketed EDITOR PICKS text is in Swedish. In English: row 3 — "look for the close-up of the slipper with the strap around the heel"; row 4 — "the price graphic at the end". Rows 1–2 are NEW FOOTAGE (bare feet on a cold kitchen floor at dawn; an old worn slipper sliding off a heel on basement stairs, then the crushed heel in close-up) — no product in frame in those two rows.
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
